name: TOGAF-Plus System Architecture Document (SAD) Swarm
description: Multi-agent swarm for planning, mapping processes, generating UML & C4 diagrams, generating PlantUML technical code structures, conceptual-logical-physical data modeling, delta analysis, and vision-guided diagram validation.

outputs.spec: TOGAF-Plus System Architecture Document (SAD) for prime-silo Application Architecture & Runtime Environment. Target length: 4500 words. Structure: Scope and Context, Business & Process Mapping (BPMN to Service), Application & UML Design (C4, Use-Case, Sequence, Robustness), Technical Code Blueprints (PlantUML), Data Architecture (Conceptual-Logical-Physical), Gap & Impact Analysis, and Vision-Verified Diagram Appendices.

tasks.description: Planner Agent: Outline a TOGAF-Plus compliant System Architecture Document (SAD) targeting 'prime-silo Application Architecture & Runtime Environment'. Define the scope, boundaries, stakeholders, and draft the Scope and Context section. Ensure the plan includes mappings for C4 models, UML diagrams, data models, and BPMN swimlanes.

Process Architect: Document the core business processes of the system 'prime-silo Application Architecture & Runtime Environment'. Map the workflows from pure business process models (BPMN style) to automated application services using Mermaid flowchart swimlane syntax. Query the knowledge graph (`query_graph`) first.

UML Designer: Design the structural and behavioral views of 'prime-silo Application Architecture & Runtime Environment'. Generate Use-Case diagrams, Sequence interaction flows, Robustness diagrams (Boundary, Entity, Control), and the C4 Model (Context, Container, Component layers) using Mermaid syntax.

Technical Architect: Formulate detailed code skeletons and structural relationships for the application components in 'prime-silo Application Architecture & Runtime Environment'. Use PlantUML class syntax to create detailed class skeletons from which physical code skeletons could be generated.

Data Architect: Model the data storage and structures of 'prime-silo Application Architecture & Runtime Environment'. Provide a conceptual entity relationship diagram (ERD) using Mermaid, a logical table schema definition (keys, relationships), and a physical database representation mapping (indexes, table engines, Neo4j schema definitions).

Delta Analyst: Analyze the delta between baseline current state and target state. Identify components to be created, updated, or decommissioned (Gap Analysis). Perform Impact Analysis covering security, downstream integration, and infrastructure.

Publishing Editor: Collect all draft sections and Mermaid/PlantUML diagram source files. Run the syntax verification CLI tools (`verify_diagram.py`) on each block. Refine the final System Architecture Document (SAD) section-by-section using sliding window critique loops to ensure high editorial quality and that the final output satisfies the target length of 4500 words, writing it to 'data_out/TOGAF_Plus_SAD_prime_silo.md'.

metadata.notes: Single-laptop optimized TOGAF-Plus SAD report swarm featuring Mermaid diagrams, PlantUML blueprints, and custom syntax verification.
